import re

def main(input):
    
    # Define regex patterns
    sentry_link_pattern = r"<(https://sentry-v2[^\|]+)\|"
    message_pattern = r"\*\*([a-zA-Z]+Error)\*\*"
    adapter_name_pattern = r"adapter:\s*`([^`]+)`"
    last_line_pattern = r"last_line:\s*`([^`]+)`"
    issue_id_pattern = r"issues/(\d+)/"

    # Extract using regex
    sentry_link = re.search(sentry_link_pattern, input["sentry_link"])
    message = input["message"].replace('```', '')
    adapter_name = re.search(adapter_name_pattern, input["adapter_name"])
    last_line = re.search(last_line_pattern, input["adapter_name"])
    issue_id = re.search(issue_id_pattern, input["sentry_link"])

    # Store results in a dictionary
    result = {
        "sentry_link": sentry_link.group(1) if sentry_link else None,
        "message": message,
        "adapter_name": adapter_name.group(1) if adapter_name else None,
        "last_line": last_line.group(1) if last_line else None,
        "issue_id": issue_id.group(1) if issue_id else None,
    }

    return result
